verdict.rationale: PagerDuty documents a broad REST API for configuration/user/workflow management, an Events API v2, V3 webhooks, and an official MCP server (with a live hosted endpoint) letting AI clients trigger/manage incidents, confirming strong API-driven parity with UI actions. However, no evidence explicitly confirms 100% feature parity between API and UI, and community comments note at least one case (OIDC/Azure AD SSO config) requiring manual support intervention outside normal UI/API self-service, suggesting some settings aren't fully API/UI accessible. Missing for 10: an explicit parity statement or audit showing all UI functions are API-exposed, and independent verification beyond vendor docs.
